subject: tu:game/enemy/enemy
value:
THE FLIP GATE FOR game/enemy/enemy.c, MEASURED FUNCTION BY FUNCTION at commit 1f8ecb211 with `python tools/gdl/fndiff.py game/enemy/enemy.c <fn> --ops`. The work order's premise is that closing the seven open functions flips the TU, and that a flip does not require deleting the ten pins because EQUIVALENT functions link through postprocessed objects. That premise is sound; what it does not say is that FOUR of the seven are COUNT-ASYMMETRIC, and per claim.law.webfrank-cannot-close-a-count-asymmetric-residual.20260831.v1 a count-asymmetric residual is outside EVERY postprocessor class however register-flavoured it looks. So those four cannot be served by a rule at all and must close at SOURCE or the TU does not flip.

THE SEVEN, with live counts. COUNT-SYMMETRIC (postprocessor-eligible if they stay that way): do_enemy_move T905/O905, multiset DIFFERS `target-only: +1 addi +1 lwz  ours-only: -2 fmr`; damage_enemy T571/O571, `target-only: +1 b +1 bgt  ours-only: -1 beq -1 cror`; move_logic00 T244/O244, multiset IDENTICAL, 53 differing words all REGFIELD-ONLY. COUNT-ASYMMETRIC (rule-ineligible by construction): move_logic10 T1085/O1087 `ours-only: -2 fmr`; generate_enemy T242/O241 `target-only: +1 mr`; move_logic22 T227/O228 `ours-only: -1 mr`; fn_80046680 T117/O118 `ours-only: -1 mr`.

THREE OF THE FOUR ARE ONE FAMILY, and it is a family the corpus has already closed as source-unreachable. fn_80046680 and move_logic22 both pay an ADDR16_LO home copy -- the target forms a file-scope address directly into its home register, ours routes the low half through a scratch and copies. fn_80046680 is NAMED IN THE P ROSTER of claim.law.addrlo-home-copy-class-is-general-temp-and-shadow-coupled.20260901.v1 (40 functions over 2983 paired, S = 0 in 953 opportunities); move_logic22 carries the identical shape with a VOLATILE home (r4), which is why the census, counting only callee-saved homes, did not list it. claim.law.addr16-lo-address-homed-via-r0-is-source-unreachable.20260831.v2 measured TWELVE candidate discriminants across that census and all twelve fail to separate the population, with a working positive control proving the search could have found a real one. generate_enemy pays the same copy in the OTHER direction (target-only `mr`), the direction claim.law.dead-local-identity-reuse-also-closes-ours-only-home-copies.20260831.v1 explicitly scopes as source-unreachable once the dead-carrier enumeration is empty -- and this run measured that enumeration empty by NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL proof.

CONSEQUENCE, stated plainly so the next order does not re-derive it: game/enemy/enemy.c cannot flip until the ADDR16_LO home-copy class is broken, and that class is currently the best-evidenced source-unreachable result in the corpus. The three count-symmetric functions are worth finishing on their own merits -- move_logic00 in particular is now a provenance-complete value-equality rule candidate -- but finishing all three still leaves four functions and no flip. An order that wants the flip should be an order that attacks the home-copy class image-wide, where the payoff is 40+ functions rather than two.
